tools.name: verify_reference
tools.description: Check one reference against OpenAlex (by DOI, then title) and arXiv (by arXiv id). Returns status verified (title, first author and year agree) | partial (title agrees; the year is off or no authors were given) | mismatch (wrong first author or title, or a DOI/arXiv id that points elsewhere) | not_found | unchecked (the services could not be asked), with the matched record and the reasons. Give as much as you have; a generic title alone is weak evidence.

tools.name: verify_bibtex
tools.description: Check every entry of a BibTeX text (up to 60) and return a verdict per citekey plus counts.

tools.name: lookup_reference
tools.description: Clean metadata (title, authors, year, venue, DOI) for a DOI, arXiv id or OpenAlex id.

tools.name: search_works
tools.description: Find candidate papers by words in the title (OpenAlex). Use to resolve a vague reference before verifying it.

tools.name: citation_neighbours
tools.description: What a paper cites (its first references) and the most-cited papers citing it, for a DOI or OpenAlex id.
